Frequently Asked Questions
Will my UniFi server be backed up with HostiFi?
Yes, this is supported on all our UniFi hosting plans. You get 5 days of backups with the $19/month plan, 30 days with the $99/month plan, and 90 days with the $249/month plan. For any custom Enterprise plans, unlimited backups are included.
How does HostiFi compare to using a UDM Pro for hosting the controller?
Ubiquiti's Dream Machine lineup works relatively well for single premise installations, but it has its risks. These range from potential hardware failures, power outages and any software update stability issues.
By moving the UniFi Controller into the cloud with HostiFi, you get automatic backups, tested updates and no hardware to maintain, which is perfect for growing MSPs or large installation environments.
Another major benefit is the user management. With HostiFi the tedious task of inviting new users to each UniFi Dream Machine you have is gone, simply invite them once to the HostiFi server.
Which UniFi devices are supported with HostiFi?
We do maintain a full list of the supported UniFi devices , but all UniFi access points, UniFi switches, UXG gateways and managed accessories are supported. Some accessories such as the UniFi Ultra switches and the UniFi UPS don't support SSH, but adoption can be completed with our free HostiFi Device Discovery Tool .
Can I use a custom domain and with HostiFi UniFi hosting?
Yes. By default we will create a subdomain of hostifi.com for you to use, but you can also set up your own domain name for your server.
Does HostiFi support the UniFi mobile app?
Yes, we do. You can download the UniFi Network app from the App Store or Google Play , then follow our guide to connect it to your server.
How are UniFi firmware and software updates handled by HostiFi?
We handle all of the server and UniFi controller updates and roll out these out, once our testing process has been completed. If you do need your server updated before this however, please let us know . Updates for individual devices, such as gateways, access points and switches is under your control, so you can choose when and how to deploy them.
Can I migrate my existing UniFi controller to HostiFi?
Yes, it's easy to migrate your existing sites using the site migration wizard built right into UniFi, and this can be done completely remotely. We also have a guide on how to add new devices . However, if you need assistance, every UniFi plan we offer - comes with included migration assistance for no additional charge, just reach out to our support team for help.
Where are your servers located?
We use Vultr as our infrastructure provider and we can move your server to a location of your choosing in North America, Europe, Asia, or Australia.
Is it easy to upgrade if needed?
Yes, if you need to upgrade your plan, you can do so from app.hostifi.com or you can let our team know. We will take care of the server and billing changes. No migration or downtime involved.
What is the scope of your support?
Our team provides support for both the server and the devices via live chat, phone, and email.

HostiFi - White Labeling
Learn about the white labelling services we offer
Reilly Chase
Last updated: October 6, 2026
The majority of our customers are IT service providers, who are using our service as part of their offering to their own customers. As such, the ability to provide a completely white labeled product, in which the end user is unaware of HostiFi being the server provider, is important to our customers.
White Label Servers
By default, HostiFi servers use a hostifi.com URL. If you want to use your own custom domain instead, setup a CNAME record with your DNS provider pointing to your HostiFi URL. See our guides on how to use your own custom domain name with your UniFi or UISP servers for more detailed instructions. Once you have customized your domain name, there is no remaining reference to HostiFi on your servers, and you will automatically have a valid certificate pointing to your domain.
White Label Billing
You are able to purchase multiple HostiFi products, which you can then resell to your customers on whatever terms you have established with the customer. By billing your customer and paying HostiFi separately, your customer will not see any references to HostiFi.
White Label Professional Services
Our HostiFi Professional Services team can provide a white label experience by working with your customers using your ticket system, your domain for emails, or your phone number.

We used to offer a free plan on a shared server, what happens if you are still on this?

Last updated: September 26, 2026
In the past, we used to offer a free plan for UniFi hosting - however this was discontinued a while back, but existing users can still use it without any issues.
HostiFi Free Plan vs HostiFi Paid Plans
HostiFi Free Plan
No longer accepting new customer sign ups
Shared server resources
Updates are pushed out via HostiFi Devolpment Team and will apply to everyone
HostiFi Paid Plan
Have access to app.hostifi.com to add admins, users and more

How do I know if I am on a free plan?
Our paid UniFi servers URLs start with m0, UISP with n0 and Omada with o0. The free UniFi plan URL starts with p01.

What is HostiFi Export?
HostiFi Export helps you easily export data from UISP or UniFi servers
Alex Lowe
Last updated: September 26, 2026
HostiFi Export allows you easily export the data of what devices you have on UISP or UniFi servers. Data gets shown on the web interface and then you can export that data to a CSV format. The new app can found at export.hostifi.com .
What data can I get from it?
It'll pull the following data:
Device Name
Device Model
Firmware Version
EOL or LTS Status
Site attached to
IP address
URL to controller
MAC Address
BSSID(s)
Offline or online status

HostiFi - What Is the Device Discovery Tool?
Learn about our new tool designed to replace the old Ubiquiti Device Discovery Tool
Alex Lowe
Last updated: October 6, 2026
The new HostiFi Device Discovery Tool is now available and can be downloaded for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android.
To download, visit our mini-site here ‍
The app is designed to be a direct replacement for the legacy Ubiquiti Device Discovery Tool, that underneath was a legacy Chrome Application. Chrome Apps were killed off by Google, so you can’t download anymore and it is impossible to run. So we decided to make a replacement.
For now, the app allows you to scan a local subnet for nearby Ubiquiti devices that are pending adoption. It'll show you the firmware, IP address, MAC address, device type and device name.

analysis.text: 払っているのは、Ubiquiti 機器で組んだ顧客のネットワークを代わりに運営する事業者だ。こうした事業者は HostiFi のサーバーを自社の独自ドメインで顧客に再販し、自分で請求をかける。創業者自身も、顧客網を一元管理したかった IT サービス事業者だった。
導入先が増えるたびに、顧客ごとの Ubiquiti ネットワークを別々に見て回る手間が増える。それを1台のサーバーに集めたいという、創業者自身が IT サービス業で抱えた不便が出発点だった。また、旧 Ubiquiti の機器発見ツールは廃止された Chrome アプリの上で動いていたため、使えなくなった。HostiFi はこの穴も無料ツールで埋めている。
独自ドメインで再販している事業者は、自分の顧客への名乗りと請求の仕組みを HostiFi のサーバーの上に組んでいるため、乗り換えるとその組み直しが要る。一方で、サーバー上の機器データは HostiFi 自身が CSV で書き出せるツールを出しているので、データを抱え込んで離れにくくする仕掛けは弱い。
